name: quality-guardian
description: A quality engineering toolkit for AI agents: reduces hallucinations with evidence-based reasoning, optimizes context quality via targeted file reading, eliminates AI-generated UI patterns, and enforces post-change verification with lint/typecheck/test/build.
descriptionZh: AI 质量工程师：通过证据链推理降低幻觉，通过定向读取优化上下文质量，通过反模式检测消除 AI 感 UI，通过自动验证确保修改后可用。包含 4 个技能、1 个质量审查 Agent、实时反模式拦截 Hook 和一键质量检查命令。
